{{Quote|I support our brave soldiers whether they come from the clone factories, or from any of the thousands of systems loyal to the Republic.|[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], addressing the Senate in a speech speaking against the creation of more clone troopers|<ref name="Pursuit">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>}}
The '''Republic Military''', also known as the '''Republic Forces''' and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as the '''Republic Armed Forces''', was the [[Army/Legends|Army]], [[Navy/Legends|Naval]] and [[Starfighter Corps/Legends|Starfighter]] forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Military was lead by the [[Minister of Defense (Republic)|Minister]] and [[Ministry of Defense]], while [[Republic officer/Legends|Republic officers]], [[Republic soldier|soldiers]], [[Republic trooper|troopers]], [[Republic crewman|crewmen]], and [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] made up the military. They were organized into the [[Republic Army]], the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], and the [[Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|Republic Starfighter Corps]]. The [[Senate Hall guards|Republic Senate Guardsmen]] and their successors the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]], were not part of the Military. It was dissolved during the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] and replaced by the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]]. However, it was reestablished as the Republic Armed Forces&mdash;also known as the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]&mdash;during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and eventually reorganized into the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].

==History==
{{Main|Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Old Sith Wars|Great Galactic War|Cold War (Galactic Republic&ndash;Sith Empire)|Galactic War|New Sith Wars|Clone Wars/Legends}}
[[File:RepublicMiliaryKotORCG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Positions in the Republic Military during the [[Jedi Civil War]], from left to right&mdash;Republic trooper, pilot, officer and naval officer.]]
For most of the Republic's history, its military had been a loose collection of fleets and soldiers from across the galaxy. Each member planet contributed forces to the whole, and each force brought its own arms, uniforms, ranks, and traditions.<ref name="Old Republic Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> 

After the devastation of the [[Jedi Civil War]], the Republic rebuilt its forces in the decades that followed. Those in command went to great lengths to promote unity and camaraderie. Ranks, uniforms, and equipment were standardized as much as possible. Recruitment and training programs became universal, with unit memberships and starship crews intentionally mixed to prevent divisions by species or homeworld. Troops learned to fight alongside Jedi as they always had, but they also trained to fight without any Jedi at all, so they wouldn't become too dependent on them—as had happened in the past. These initiatives continued for decades, marked by setbacks and constant revisions. But over time, these efforts transformed the Republic military into a more cohesive and capable force.<ref name="Old Republic Encyclopedia" />

After the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]] and the death of [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Lord Hoth]], the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] disbanded the Republic's military forces and replaced them with the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]]. It also placed the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] under the Senate's control.

When the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] posed a huge threat to the Republic, the issue of recreating the Republic Military became a large debate and eventually became the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] when [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was voted emergency powers by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]. The Grand Army made up one part of the Republic Armed Forces ("RAF"), which was headed by [[Republic High Command/Legends|Republic High Command]], which, until the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], was under the command of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], and only afterward came under the total control of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the Republic Military was transformed into the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].

==Organization==
The Republic's military follows a strict chain of command to maintain order and clarity of authority. All forces ultimately answer to the Senate, typically represented by the Supreme Chancellor in strategic matters. The Supreme Commander, the Republic's highest-ranking officer, advises on and oversees the execution of military plans. Orders flow down to army generals and navy admirals, who coordinate their forces to carry them out.<ref name="Old Republic Encyclopedia" />  

===Role===
The primary function of the Republic military was the defense of the Republic and its citizens, particularly against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Beyond front-line combat, the military also carried out a variety of secondary functions. These included anti-piracy patrols, suppression of smuggling and raiding activities, and the disruption of illegal arms trafficking, which expanded during periods of galactic conflict. Criminals captured in such operations were typically transferred to [[Planetary Security Forces|planetary security forces]], though such transfers could be delayed by ongoing military objectives.<ref name="Old Republic Encyclopedia" />

The Republic military also played a significant role in humanitarian and civic operations. Its forces provided security and logistical support for relief missions and colonization projects, such as the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|recolonization of Taris]], ensuring the transport of supplies and personnel. Soldiers were often rotated between combat and non-combat assignments to balance operational strain and maintain long-term readiness.<ref name="Old Republic Encyclopedia" />

===Branch Relations===
Throughout its history, the Republic Military grappled with internal tensions between its primary branches. Hardly any of these forces worked together willingly, and friction between the Republic Navy and infantry units was sharp and highly contentious. Traditionally, the Republic's navy was regarded as its most valued military asset, and fleet commanders and crews were well aware of this. They often leveraged their importance by demanding higher wages from the Senate and expecting unconditional cooperation from ground forces, who depended on them for transportation and support. Ground forces weren't just devalued by the Navy—their pay was lower across the board, and equipment standards varied widely from one planet's forces to the next.<ref name="Old Republic Encyclopedia" />

===Proper Address===
Members of the Republic military were mandated to use rank or the honorific "sir" when addressing superiors, irrespective of [[Gender/Legends|gender]]. The policy was intended to simplify interactions among [[Species/Legends|species]] with varied or unclear gender norms. However, it was controversial—critics argued that it created confusion and felt inappropriate for those who did not identify as male.<ref name="Old Republic Encyclopedia" />
